summary: Iteration 85 - Quote to Project Conversion and Irregular Flow Testing. All backend tests passed (8/8). Frontend UI verified: Projects page shows 6 stat cards including 'P. Irregular', orange irregular badge on projects, clicking P. Irregular card correctly filters to show only irregular projects. Both Bug #1 fixes verified: POST /api/quotes/{id}/approve and send-to-implementation work with exception headers. Feature #2 verified: send-to-implementation creates project and deletes quote. Feature #3 verified: project inherits is_irregular and irregular_exceptions, stats include irregular count, UI shows badge and filter.

issues: HTML hydration warning: <span> inside <tbody> - cosmetic only, does not affect functionality

seed_data_creation: Created test quotes during backend testing. Projects PRY-2026-03-00X-PRI with irregular flags created from converted quotes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 85 complete - Quote to Project Conversion and Irregular Flow. Key findings: 1) POST /api/quotes/{id}/approve requires 'Orden de Compra' attachment and returns 422 IRREGULAR when status != Enviada without x-exception-reason header. 2) POST /api/quotes/{id}/send-to-implementation returns 422 IRREGULAR when status != Pagada without exception headers. 3) send-to-implementation creates project via _create_project_from_quote function and deletes quote after conversion. 4) Project inherits is_irregular=true and irregular_exceptions[] from quote. 5) GET /api/projects/stats includes 'irregular' field with count. 6) Projects.jsx has 6 stat cards: Total, Pendientes, En Proceso, Detenidos, Finalizados, P. Irregular. 7) data-testid='stat-p.-irregular' for the irregular filter card. 8) data-testid='project-irregular-badge' for orange 'Irregular' badge. 9) Clicking P. Irregular card sets statusFilter='irregular' which filters p.is_irregular === true.

bug_1_approve_with_exception_headers.behavior: Returns 422 with IRREGULAR prefix when status != Enviada and no x-exception-reason header. Requires Orden de Compra attachment.

bug_1_send_to_implementation_with_except.behavior: Returns 422 with IRREGULAR prefix when status != Pagada and no exception reason. With headers, marks quote irregular, creates project, deletes quote.
